contracts.must: Read current authority before consequential meta action.
Freshness includes main, active branches/PRs, Drive mirrors and current pointers.
Diverged branches require semantic reconciliation.
Every experiment names the decision it can change.
Prompt/file/test count cannot substitute for outcome evidence.
Fingerprint before creating a new prompt/module/engine.
Extend verified engine unless a true new engine is justified.
Do not allocate shared SI IDs when active branch collisions are possible.
Prefer cheapest evidence likely to change the decision.
Prefer reversible canary before broad rollout.
Bound active meta-improvement work.
Meta-cycle declares a production-return target.
Evidence classes cannot substitute for each other.
A write claim is not persisted evidence.
Material writes require readback.
Readback verifies non-empty expected semantic anchors.
Readback verifies branch/folder/file destination.
Partial writes are PARTIAL, never PASS.
Recovery resumes missing writes without duplicating accepted writes.
GitHub/Drive parity is semantic state parity, not mandatory byte identity.
Candidate rollout defines rollback trigger and target.
Check whether intervention creates process/document bloat.
Repeated failure after local repair reopens model/boundary.
AI agreement/document volume carry no independent authority.
No universal promotion from synthetic/meta-only fixtures.
Current v2 lifecycle and production authorities are regression-protected.
Human/market/provider claims require their own evidence.
Repeated finding enters learning as candidate until lifecycle passes.
Self-improvement changes pass the same lifecycle.
Unknown benefit/cost/effect remains qualitative/null.
Stop research when additional work no longer changes a material decision.
Cycle closure requires readback evidence for all claimed material writes.
